attchmntText: Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release on the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026".
sm_name: Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited
voiceSummary: Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported sales of 1145 crores rupees, which were flat compared to the previous year. Profit after tax was 196 crores rupees, representing a 7% decline year over year. The profitability impact was attributed to commodity cost fluctuations, raw material and energy cost headwinds, and unfavorable foreign exchange rates, partially offset by productivity programs. The company continued to invest in innovation and advertising. Key product launches included upgraded Vicks ZzzQuil with Ashwagandha, Vicks medicated lozenges, and Whisper Period Pants. The announcement was made on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
sm_name: Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited
voiceSummary: Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 12, 2026. Profit for the six months ended September 30, 2026, was 32,211 lakhs, compared to 40,192 lakhs in the previous year. Revenue from operations for the six-month period stood at 2,03,654 lakhs, down from 2,03,720 lakhs previously. Earnings per share for the six months were 99.23, compared to 123.26 in the prior year. The statutory auditors, Kalyaniwalla & Mistry LLP, issued a limited review report stating no material misstatements were found. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were 2,12,938 lakhs.
